description.value: Bright Jenny Coffee is a Kelowna specialty coffee roaster that runs a café alongside its online bean-subscription business, sourcing single-origin coffees from Brazil, Ethiopia, Colombia, and Guatemala. The café has a food menu in addition to espresso drinks, and mobile ordering lets customers order ahead and have their drink ready on arrival. It is an independent local roaster with a wholesale program and a distinctly hands-on, small-team character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bright Jenny Coffee is an active Kelowna café and coffee roaster with a live Shopify storefront, mobile ordering, and an in-store café menu (drink and food sections). The phone number (250) 860 8848 on the website matches the OSM tag +1 250 860 8848, confirming contact details. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other amenity criteria, so those remain null; takeout is confirmed by the mobile ordering banner ('Skip the line, order ahead, and have your drink waiting when you roll in').
concerns: No street address present in OSM record or recoverable from the fetched website pages; the Locations subpage was not included in the fetch and may contain the address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open café and roastery in Kelowna with a live website and mobile ordering; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking coffee, drinks, and food.
